opening.argument: The video presents a practical walkthrough for using Uber vouchers received through the GOBD sale, with the description expressly explaining how to use them. It instructs viewers that “This promo code will simply be copied,” while showing a reward page with an Rs. 50 Uber voucher, a Copy Code control, and terms describing SMS steps tied to a registered mobile number. The later voucher message and payment-menu screens illustrate the redemption process, but they do not establish that the voucher is authentic or successfully redeemed, nor do they show fees or loss. Requests to like, share, watch, and subscribe remain ordinary audience-engagement prompts.

citations.quote: Is Video mai Aapko GOBD Sale mai Jo Uber Voucher Mile hain Unko Kese use Karna hai yeh batane wala hun
This promo code will simply be copied.
